title: Verify native Replay recording through multi-scene coexistence
admission: Dependency-ready F05 needs executable native-record proof, not only hasReplay or WebView bridge data. This bounded simulator slice prepares the existing physical coexistence gate without expanding Replay scene-correctness scope.
environment: Fresh task-owned iPad Pro13-inch(M4) simulator on installed iOS27.0/24A434 through Xcode27.1 SDK27.1. Physical multi-window device still required for F05 closure.
protocol: Freeze fixture source, build, every app Mach-O, fresh run and exact manifest; clean install with absent bundle/data before launch.
Enable existing native Replay at100 percent with default privacy; no WebView, manual Replay records or fabricated OS callbacks. Add only a small native UIView color stimulus to the existing host.
Before opening B, wait for A Home plus true live Replay context and actual record-count growth. Record live native topology and process representative before and after the stimulus.

Open actual B through the existing scene driver. Require distinct native sessions; preserve observed activation/geometry without assuming simultaneous visibility. Capture B Home and then B Detail record growth after real navigation.
Close actual B, requiring the OS disconnect callback and absence from connectedScenes. Reactivate A, navigate to its Detail, and require fresh native record growth plus exact active RUM ownership.

Join all recorded ownership to independent mapper views and the complete backend session view inventory; reject stale/run-mismatched rows, unexpected errors or crashes, unknown record owners and backend mismatches.
Export full evidence and a compact durable summary. Verify app/data absence, process completion and source/protected state; delete only the newly created test simulator after use.

decisive_tests.native_topology: A attached; B not yet opened
decisive_tests.recording: count for observed active representative increases above live before-stimulus baseline

decisive_tests.native_topology: Distinct A/B connected scene sessions; preserve activation states
Both actual scene sessions remain connected
decisive_tests.recording: new B Detail recorder count increases

decisive_tests.native_topology: B actual disconnect precedes A Detail; A alone remains connected
decisive_tests.recording: new A Detail recorder count increases after teardown

negative_controls: foreign record view ID or session
late baseline or topology after critical boundary
recording from WebView or manual injection
wrong backend owner or incomplete inventory
stop_rule: Preserve first failed admission or strict assertion before correction; at most two equivalent environment failures. Do not substitute synthetic disconnect, reset the oracle or infer physical acceptance.
closure_rule: Accept this simulator slice only with R1-R4 native recording/ownership, complete backend inventory and cleanup. F05 remains open until the same coexistence contract runs on a physical multi-window device.

attempts.reason: Fixture treated optional RUMCoreContext.viewID as a dictionary key. Add explicit non-nil admission; native tests/scenario did not run.

implementation.native: Existing scene driver plus four asynchronous native-context checkpoints; passive topology, default Replay privacy and ordinary UIView stimulus. No SDK production change.
implementation.oracle: replay_contract.py checks complete manifest/steps, precritical counters, independent exact mapper owners, actual disconnect and complete backend inventory.
implementation.automation: Existing acceptance.py scenario branch with every Mach-O identity, persisted raw native records before validation and verified final app/data absence.
